blocks.title: Lesson Objectives
blocks.content:
- Explain what is meant by variation within a species
- Describe genetic and environmental causes of variation
- Explain how genetic and environmental factors combine

blocks.title: Definition
blocks.content: **Variation within a species** — differences between individuals of the same species.

blocks.title: Genetic variation
blocks.content: **Genetic variation** is caused by different alleles. **Mutation** can introduce new alleles into a population.

blocks.title: Environmental variation
blocks.content: **Environmental variation** is caused by differences in diet, climate, or lifestyle — not inherited.

blocks.title: Combined effects
blocks.content: Most characteristics show **combined genetic and environmental effects**. Height is a classic example.

blocks.title: Sources of genetic variation
blocks.content: **Meiosis** and **random fertilisation** increase genetic variation by producing new allele combinations.

blocks.title: Exam practice
blocks.question: Define fertilisation.
blocks.content: **Fertilisation** is the fusion of gamete nuclei.
